svg.title: ARMOR-UPDATER architecture
svg.desc: ARMOR-UPDATER discovers the A.R.M.O.R. repositories of a workspace by their armor.project.json and, remotely, of the account on GitHub; compares versions; builds and verifies every install or update in an independent staging clone; checks the signature of the revision against pinned keys; and promotes it with two journalled renames, keeping the replaced checkout as a backup and an evidence line for every attempt. It has a command line and an optional Qt Quick window.

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI','Noto Sans','Noto Sans CJK SC','Microsoft YaHei','Yu Gothic','Helvetica Neue',Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif
'Segoe UI','Noto Sans','Noto Sans CJK SC','Microsoft YaHei','Yu Gothic','Helvetica Neue',Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif

svg.text: Finds the family on this PC, compares it with GitHub and installs or updates one project at a time, verified before anything is replaced.
